name: Feed La Trobe food bank
summary: A free student-run food bank at Bundoora where La Trobe students can take a tote bag of food and household items each week.
key: One tote bag of items free, once a week.
catches: Open Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays 11am to 2pm, depending on supply and volunteers.
Ground Floor of Agora, Shop 113, Bundoora.

source.label: La Trobe Student Union: Feed La Trobe

evidence.quote: one tote bag size of items away with them for free
